notes:
Context: Mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B). Team building in-app assistant + document search + reranking for feature flags and product docs. Evaluation path: started Hosted API sandbox (2-week trial), ran a 10-day POC with 3 feature teams.

Timeline (high-level):
- 2025-11-05: Intro call (AE Samira) - high-level use cases, asked for latency <150ms median for chat flows.
- 2026-02-12: Hosted API demo + quickstarts (recorded, ff_2026-02-12_Argyle-demo).
- 2026-02-15: Sandbox keys delivered; initial integration (engineering team).
- 2026-02-20 to 2026-03-03: POC load tests (locust + k6) against Hosted API; SE Diego ran tests and produced logs.
- 2026-03-03: POC sync - discussed Dedicated sizing options (ff_2026-03-03_poc-sync).
- 2026-03-09: Pricing follow-up email thread opened; waiting clarification on reserved vs burst pricing.

POC findings (technical):
- Workload mix: 68% chat-support flows, 22% document search (embeddings), 10% high-throughput reranking jobs.
- Token profile (observed averages during POC): chat prompt 60 tokens, chat completion 180 tokens; embeddings payload avg 600 tokens; reranking batches ~20 candidates, avg 150 tokens per candidate.
- Traffic characteristics: weekday peak QPS observed 11.8 (10-13 range), typical mid-day concurrency 18, nightly baseline QPS 2-3.
- Token throughput: peak tokens/sec ~1,200 tokens/s across all endpoints; median latency on Hosted API during peak ~180ms (95p ~420ms) — close but above their SLO for median.

Dedicated sizing recommendations discussed with SE:
- Recommended starting footprint: 2 x 80GB GPU workers (dedicated pool) with autoscale to +1 for burst windows. Rationale: supports target concurrency 20 with conservative KV cache and batching.
- KV/prefix caching: enable session KV cache for chat-heavy flows to reduce tokens per request by ~15-25% for repeated context.
- Batching profile: maintain short-window batching for reranking to keep latency under 300ms while amortizing cost on embeddings/rerank.
- Estimated steady-state token budget: ~2.5M tokens/day for production after on-boarding. Estimated committed throughput mapping -> 2 worker nodes.

Commercial / procurement notes:
- They want committed monthly pricing for Dedicated to hit ARR band target; sensitive to overprovisioning costs.
- Request: 12-month discounted MRC for Dedicated + credits toward onboarding and extra Support SLA for first 90 days.
- Legal: standard MSA review; security needs confirmation of SOC2 attestations and KMS integration flow.
